# ID42 Studio
> Software, AI and intelligent solutions studio. Software that doesn't just run — it gets work done. Engineering first, AI when it adds value.

## Pages
- [Português](https://id42studio.github.io/): default locale
- [English](https://id42studio.github.io/en/): English version

## Thesis
Software as a Work: systems that combine engineering, automation and artificial intelligence to
execute authorised steps of a process, validate results and route exceptions. The degree of autonomy
depends on process risk, reliability, business rules and governance.

Stages: Software as a Tool, Software as an Assistant, Software as Work.

## What we deliver
- Build: custom software, enterprise integrations, AI agents, digital platforms, SaaS, modernisation
- Operate: managed workflows, agent monitoring, application support, integration monitoring, AI quality evaluation
- Outcome: outcome-based services where acceptance criteria exist (under evaluation, subject to feasibility)

## Capabilities
- Software engineering: enterprise systems, web applications, APIs, platforms
- AI and agentic systems: agents, copilots, RAG, LLM applications, evaluation
- Automation and integration: ERP/CRM integration, workflow automation, APIs, webhooks
- Product engineering: discovery, MVP, SaaS engineering, product evolution
- Architecture and consulting: solution architecture, assessment, modernisation, AI strategy
- Intelligent operations: business rules, automation and AI with traceability and risk-proportional supervision

## How we work
Discover, Architect, Build, Validate, Operate, Evolve. The same six stages apply to conventional
software, AI, integrations, digital products and experiments.

## Products
- [VBSell](https://vbsell.com): omnichannel platform for service and commercial operations
- [BuilderMonitor](https://buildermonitor.cloud.escodoo.com): operational intelligence for construction — schedule, cost and field data above the ERP
- [Deepze](https://deepze.ai): private enterprise AI with chat and copilots over the company knowledge base, RAG inside the client infrastructure

## Labs
ID42 Labs is the studio's applied research and prototyping practice: agents and multi-agent systems,
local and private LLMs, developer tooling, open source, emerging architectures and applied AI evaluation.
